units.source_text: 十一月初，他最后记录到了一天四升水，此后每一天都在减少。

en.t: At the beginning of November, he made his final record of four liters of water in one day, and after that the amount decreased day by day.

units.source_text: 总觉得气温像是有关系，真正的实验，只能等到明年开春了。

en.t: He felt somehow that the temperature was involved, and that a real experiment would have to wait until spring opened the following year.

units.source_text: 不久，冰的碎片随着沙子开始飞舞，漫长而严酷的冬天来临了。

en.t: Before long, fragments of ice began to whirl together with the sand, and the long, harsh winter arrived.

units.source_text: 这时，他渴望得到一个较好的收音机，于是，他也帮女人干起了家庭手工活。

en.t: By then, he longed to get a better radio, so he too began helping the woman with piecework at home.

units.source_text: 洞穴中尽管有挡风的优点，但是，终日不见阳光，说得再轻松，也不敢说很容易坚持。

en.t: Although the pit had the advantage of blocking the wind, there was no sunlight all day, and however lightly one put it, it could not be called easy to endure.

units.source_text: 即使沙子被冻住了，飞沙的量却始终未见减少，清沙的活照干不误，没有休息。

en.t: Even when the sand froze, the amount of flying sand never seemed to decrease, and the work of clearing it went on as usual without rest.

units.source_text: 好几次，手冻得皲裂了，还流出了鲜血。

en.t: Several times, his hands froze until they cracked, and fresh blood even flowed out.
